question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who overperformed their xG by the most (goals minus xG)?
answer:
Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, **Phil Foden** overperformed his xG by the most. He scored **19 goals** against an xG of **11.308**, an overperformance of **+7.692**.

The next closest were Michael Olise (+4.313) and Cole Palmer (+4.168).
sql:
SELECT p.player_name,
       SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals,
       SUM(pss.xg_pss) AS xg,
       SUM(pss.goals_pss) - SUM(pss.xg_pss) AS overperformance
FROM player_season_stats pss
JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id = pss.season_id
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = pss.player_id
WHERE s.season = '2023-2024'
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 10
ORDER BY overperformance DESC;

out.notes: Filter player_season_stats on season_id for '2023-2024' (join seasons), WHERE goals_pss >= 10. Compute overperformance = goals_pss - xg_pss, ORDER BY DESC. Grain is player-season-team; if a player split clubs mid-season, rows are per-team so consider summing goals_pss and xg_pss by player_id before filtering. Join players for player_name display. Alternatively use vw_player_season_summary which already carries player_name and is pre-filtered to ENG-PL.
